create.name: Shri Anandi Ma
create.bio:
Shri Anandi Ma is an Indian meditation teacher and the head of the Kundalini Maha Yoga lineage of Shri Dhyanyogi Madhusudandas. As a young woman in Gujarat she went through an intense period of practice and visionary experience, and the elderly yogi, recognising her as his spiritual heir, trained her closely for several years. She travelled with him to the United States in 1976 and, at his request, carried on his work after he went back to India. Dileepji, who met Dhyanyogi as a boy and served as his translator, has taught alongside her ever since, and the two lead their community together.

Their path centres on shaktipat, the awakening of kundalini energy through a teacher, which Anandi Ma gives in person and at a distance, together with mantra, breath practice, chanting and meditation. Their organisation, Dhyanyoga Centers, has a meditation centre in Antioch, California, where they hold a Sunday programme of chanting, meditation, prayer for world peace and question-and-answer satsang that is also streamed online, and an ashram and temple Anandi Ma built beside the Narmada River at Nikora in Gujarat. They teach in the United States from spring to autumn and in India in the winter, and recorded workshops on practices such as pranayama and tratak are available from their store.

courses.title: Tratak (2-disc set)
courses.description: A recorded workshop in which Anandi Ma and Dileepji teach tratak, the yogic practice of steady gazing, as a support for concentration and meditation on the path of Kundalini Maha Yoga.

courses.title: Pranayama (2-disc set)
courses.description: A classic Dhyanyoga Centers workshop recording on breath control and the yogic understanding of prana. It is sold as a DVD set and can also be rented or bought as video on demand.

free_resources.title: Sunday Meditation with Anandi Ma
free_resources.description: A weekly programme streamed from Antioch at 10:30am Pacific time, with chanting, meditation to Dhyanyogi's mantra arrangement, arati, followed by satsang on the Sundays the two teachers are there. It is free to join online or in person.

free_resources.title: Satsang Replays
free_resources.description: Recordings of the question-and-answer sessions Anandi Ma and Dileepji give after Sunday meditation, free to watch on the site or on Vimeo.
